name: dorsal
description: No-frills inline AI coding assistant VS code plugin

dorsal.llmServer.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible LLM server. Works best with llama.cpp's llama-server.

dorsal.llmServer.model.description: Optional model name to request from the server, for multi-model setups (e.g. llama-swap). Leave empty to use the server's default/loaded model.

dorsal.llmServer.apiKey.description: Optional API key for the LLM server, sent as a Bearer token.

dorsal.completions.triggerMode.description: When to offer inline completions. Manual mode responds only to VS Code's Trigger Inline Suggestion action.

dorsal.completions.useInfillApi.description: Use llama.cpp's /infill API for inline completions. Disable for OpenAI-compatible chat completions.

dorsal.completions.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before requesting an inline completion after typing stops.

dorsal.completions.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to request for an inline completion.

dorsal.completions.model.description: Optional model override for inline completions. Leave empty to use the default model.

dorsal.completions.baseUrl.description: Optional server base URL override for inline completions. Leave empty to use the default LLM server.

dorsal.completions.apiKey.description: Optional API key override for inline completions. Leave empty to use the default API key.

dorsal.completions.maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to suggest for inline tab completion. 1 means only the rest of the current line; 2 includes one additional line, and so on.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.autoTrigger.description: Automatically suggest next edits after a short idle period following a change.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to request for a next-edit suggestion.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.model.description: Optional model override for next-edit suggestions. Leave empty to use the default model.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.thinkingBudge.description: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens for next-edit suggestions, for models that support extended thinking.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.useInfillApi.description: Use the server's infill API for FIM-style next-edit strategies. Disable to send prefix/suffix requests through the OpenAI-compatible completions API instead.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.strategy.description: Output strategy for next-edit suggestions. Try different fish names to optimize for small or FIM-friendly models.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.baseUrl.description: Optional server base URL override for next-edit suggestions. Leave empty to use the default LLM server.

dorsal.nextEditSuggestions.apiKey.description: Optional API key override for next-edit suggestions. Leave empty to use the default API key.

dorsal.inlineEdit.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to request for an inline quick edit.

dorsal.inlineEdit.model.description: Optional model override for inline edits. Leave empty to use the default model.

dorsal.inlineEdit.thinkingBudget.description: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens for inline edits, for models that support extended thinking.

dorsal.inlineEdit.baseUrl.description: Optional server base URL override for inline edits. Leave empty to use the default LLM server.

dorsal.inlineEdit.apiKey.description: Optional API key override for inline edits. Leave empty to use the default API key.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
